Class Player

java.lang.Object
Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents the player in the Candy Courier game. Stores the player's information, handles XP accumulation, rank progression, and player movement.

    • checkRankProgression

      public void checkRankProgression()
      Checks the player's total XP and updates their star rank according to the required promotion thresholds. Rank requirements: 1 star - 100 XP 2 stars - 500 XP 3 stars - 1400 XP 4 stars - 3000 XP 5 stars - 5500 XP
